eligibility.note: Doctors do not heal land Machine units; Steam Giant exclusion is explicitly used in the empirical paper.

evidence.section: 4 Damage redistribution / Tender observations / Other useful facts
evidence.claim: Healing is reflected by the start of the next round; legacy Tender capacity is reported per round.

executable_subset.rule: If total Doctor capacity covers all persistent damage on eligible Human combat waves, clear that damage at the round boundary before RR. Because all eligible damage becomes zero, unknown Healing-vs-RR ordering cannot change the result.
executable_subset.incomplete_reason: Allocation priority across partially healable eligible waves/slots is unresolved.
